app_image_config.layer_1_style: 1024x1024 px. STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3: High-poly 3D animation. Ensure all footprints are NEGATIVE IMPRESSIONS (sunken depressions) in the sand, not raised objects.
app_image_config.layer_3_action: A high-angle shot. The paleontologist is studying the trackway. In the foreground, two massive Spinosaurid footprints are visible. Each track features three long toe depressions. IMPORTANT: The tip of each toe must show a sharp, narrow, and deep elongated PUNCTURE MARK (the negative impression left by a claw), showing the displaced mud pushed up around the edges of the hole. There should be no solid 'nail' visible, only the deep V-shaped cavity where the claw pressed into the matrix.
